messages:
Alex: Heads-up — considering a dynamic preemption-penalty + backoff layer on the dedicated GPU autoscaler. Goal: reduce noisy preempts for bursty tenants while keeping fast burst recovery. Thoughts?

Maya: Quick Q — are we penalizing tenants that caused the preempt, or the tenant that got preempted? need clarity.

Alex: We should penalize the aggressor (the tenant that triggered preemption). Victims should get short emergency credits.

Sree: Proposal: hybrid credit + penalty. Each tenant has preempt_credit (0..100). Preempting consumes credit proportional to eviction size. If credit below threshold, apply a soft admission penalty (slower admits). Credits replenish slowly. Pseudocode:

```
# pseudo
penalty = base_penalty
penalty += preemptions_last_1h * 0.5
penalty += sla_violations * 2
penalty *= (1 + burst_size/100)
admit_rate = base_rate / (1 + penalty)
```

Replenish: +1 credit per 6h (full ~25d). Keeps sustained bursters from cycling.

Maya: Likes credit model for mental model. Two asks: 1) SLA tenants exceptions, 2) bounded latency impact (SLO accounting).

Jordan: Rollout plan: simulate on 30-day traces first (compare 99p latency and preempt counts). Then canary: 5% traffic read-only admission shim, followed by 10% with doubled backoff windows.

Dina: Ops complexity warning — ledger + multiple controllers will be tricky. Expose /debug and per-tenant history (7d). Prefer server defaults, no per-tenant knobs initially. Add operator playbook entries.

Kevin: Telemetry needs: events `penalty_applied`, `credit_consumed`, `credit_replenished`. Map credit consumption -> cost bucket for billing/showback. Alert if tenant consumes >50 credits/day.

deploy-bot: created sim job `sim/preempt-penalty-2026-03-01` -> https://ci.redwood/sim/2378 :pipeline_started

Alex: Decision (proto): implement credit ledger + penalty behind FF. Conservative defaults: slow replenishment, soft penalties. Iterate after sims.

Sree: Will draft RFC followup with formulas, ledger API (append-only), events and telemetry metrics (preempt_count, credit_delta, admit_delay_ms). Ledger should be append-only in Postgres: tenant_id, change_type, delta, reason, trace_id.

Jordan: I'll run the sim and post results here.

Dina: I'll draft operator playbook and admin reset flows.

Kevin: I'll wire dashboards and showback tags.

Alex: Thanks — ping me to join canary.
